name: 3D Molecules
author: 7e7bee5f-91be-4839-8ade-d291fc600c71
description: Multicolor 3D-printable molecule models (Spheres, Ball-and-Stick, Sticks) from a built-in library or pasted XYZ/MOL data. Simplified offline version of 3dmolekuly.vscht.cz, where you will find PubChem/PDB/CIF search, structure drawing, moving joints and spheres split for gluing.
